items.moreLabel: View ad plans & top placement pricing
items.more:
**INDIA — 24-HOUR PLANS**

• Standard listing: ₹29 weekdays / ₹39 weekends
• Featured listing: ₹59 weekdays / ₹69 weekends
• Top placement: ₹79 weekdays / ₹99 weekends

**INTERNATIONAL — 24-HOUR PLANS**

• Standard, Featured or Top placement: from $2 USD. Confirm the final price before booking.

**HOW TOP PLACEMENT WORKS**

The listed top-placement price is the starting price, not a guaranteed winning offer. If multiple advertisers want the same premium slot, you can offer more than the listed price. We will confirm the highest acceptable offer, availability and final price before payment. A higher offer does not guarantee placement until it is confirmed.

**PLACEMENT OPTIONS**

• Standard: regular position in the Sponsored panel.
• Featured: higher priority than standard listings.
• Top placement: priority at the top of the panel for the agreed 24-hour period, subject to availability.

**HOW TO BOOK**

Send your website or social media link, banner or promotional text, target country, preferred dates and desired placement. We will confirm availability and payment details before publishing.

All plans run for 24 hours from the agreed start time. Weekend prices are introductory suggestions, not verified traffic-based rates. Views, clicks and sales are not guaranteed. All ads are subject to review and approval.
